High-resolution distribution map of apple orchards in China based on multisource data

April 7, 2026 W. Xie, Y. Song, X. Cui et al. orchard mapping, China, remote sensing, agriculture, multisource data
Read the source article

Quick summary

This Scientific Data paper documents a high-resolution orchard map for China, showing how multisource remote-sensing workflows are being used to make crop-specific agricultural geography measurable at national scale.

Key takeaways

  • The paper presents a high-resolution map of apple orchard distribution across China.
  • The dataset is built from multisource information rather than a single imagery stream.
  • The work belongs to a growing wave of crop-specific mapping products for agricultural monitoring.
  • Such maps can support yield analysis, land-use planning and sector-specific environmental assessment.
  • The article underscores how remote sensing is moving from broad land-cover classes toward crop-level inventories.
